title: Sale of Immovable Property
content: Sale of immovable property of the value of one hundred rupees and upwards can be made only by a registered instrument. Delivery of tangible immovable property takes place when the seller places the buyer in possession.

title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property
content: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof.
